info.name: Techaven API
info.description:
Complete API documentation for Techaven e-commerce platform (Flow Diagram v1.0).

**Seed credentials** (run `npm run seed` first):
- Admin: admin@techaven.mw / admin12345
- Buyer: buyer@techaven.mw / password123
- Seller: seller@techaven.mw / seller12345
- Delivery Agent: agent@techaven.mw / agent12345

**Response envelope:** All endpoints return JSON with `success`, `message`, `data`. Use `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` for protected routes.

**Organization:**
- **Mobile App:** Onboarding, Auth, User (**`GET /api/user/points/balances`**, **`POST /api/user/points/redeem`** → wallet MWK), Products (paginated `data.products`), public **subscription packages**, Categories, Cart, Orders (**`GET /api/orders/mine/paid`**, **`POST /api/orders/:id/pay/airtel`** Airtel MW direct push (`msisdn`), **`POST /api/orders/:id/pay/paychangu`**, confirm delivery optional **`file_url`**), **Wishlist** (`GET/POST /api/wishlist`, `GET/DELETE /api/wishlist/:productId`), Addresses, Wallet, Payment Methods, Notifications, **Shops** (**`GET /api/shops`** all shops; detail `followers_count`, **`points_mwk_per_point`**; optional `is_following`; **POST/DELETE** `/api/shops/:id/follow`; **`GET /api/shops/:id/products`**), Search, Help, App Info, public **platform settings** (seller commission %, **`default_points_mwk_per_point`** for general loyalty redemptions), SMS, Webhooks (**Airtel Money Malawi** direct Collection: **`POST /api/webhooks/airtel`** (callback), **`GET /api/webhooks/airtel`** (health); OAuth + payments via `openapi.airtel.mw`; **Pay Changu** = **`POST /api/webhooks/paychangu`**, **GET .../paychangu/callback**)
- **Admin:** Dashboard, **Platform settings** (seller commission %, **`default_points_mwk_per_point`**, deduction summary & by-seller), **Subscription packages** & **Shop subscriptions**, Shops, Orders, Courier Services, Onboarding Slides, Banners, Audit Logs, Withdrawals, Notifications, Categories
- **Seller:** Products (paginated + variants), Orders, Dashboard, **Subscription** (subscribe, **pay/paychangu** for mobile-money collect, cancel, resume), Earnings, **Shop profile** (`PATCH /api/sellers/:shopId/shop` incl. **`points_mwk_per_point`** MWK per loyalty point for buyer redemptions, **POST** `.../shop/logo` multipart `logo`, web UI `/seller-shop.html`), **Shop followers** (`GET /api/sellers/:shopId/followers`), Notifications
- **Delivery Agent:** Jobs, Profile

**Notes:** Featured/hot/new product segment endpoints were removed — filter client-side from `GET /api/products`. See `docs/SUBSCRIPTION_PACKAGES.md` for seller plans.

**Airtel Money (Malawi):** Direct Collection API (`openapi.airtel.mw`). Server env: `AIRTEL_CLIENT_ID`, `AIRTEL_CLIENT_SECRET`, optional `AIRTEL_ENV=production`, `AIRTEL_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. Local CLI tests: `npm run test-airtel` (OAuth token), `npm run test-airtel-payment -- <msisdn>`. Full guide: `docs/AIRTEL_WEBHOOK.md`.

item.name: Mobile App (Customer APIs)
item.description: Customer-facing mobile app APIs. **User loyalty:** `GET /api/user/points/balances`, `POST /api/user/points/redeem` (auth). **Shops:** `GET /api/shops` (all shops, no auth), `GET /api/shops/:id` (detail + `followers_count`, `points_mwk_per_point`; optional Bearer for `is_following`), `GET /api/shops/:id/products`, `POST/DELETE /api/shops/:id/follow` (auth). **Wishlist:** `GET/POST /api/wishlist`, `GET/DELETE /api/wishlist/:productId` (all auth). Set collection **Bearer** (`{{access_token}}`) for protected requests, or override per request (e.g. public shop list uses **noauth**).

**Bearer: customer (or any authenticated user).** `GET /api/user/points/balances`. Returns `data.total_points`, `data.currency` (MWK), `data.balances[]` with `shop_id`, `shop_name`, `points`, `points_mwk_per_point` (null if seller has not set a rate), `redeemable_mwk_estimate`. Points are tracked **per shop** (from completed orders); `shop_id` **0** is the **General** bucket for legacy/unallocated totals. Call this before redeem to see rates.

**Bearer: customer.** `POST /api/user/points/redeem`. Body: **`shop_id`** (integer; use **0** for General/legacy bucket), **`points`** (positive integer). Converts points to **MWK** at the shop’s **`points_mwk_per_point`** (set by seller via `PATCH /api/sellers/:shopId/shop`) or, for `shop_id` 0, at **`default_points_mwk_per_point`** from admin platform settings / `GET /api/platform-settings`. Credits **`wallet`** and creates a completed wallet transaction. Response: `points_redeemed`, `mwk_credited`, `wallet_balance`, `remaining_points`.

item.name: 6. Orders
item.description: Customer orders. Pay with **Airtel Money** (`POST /api/orders/:id/pay/airtel`, body `msisdn`) or **Pay Changu** (`POST /api/orders/:id/pay/paychangu`, body `tx_ref`). Paid orders: `GET /api/orders/mine/paid`.

request.description: Create order from items array + shipping_address_id. courier_service_id: from GET /api/courier-services (seed has ids 1-4). Seed: Login as Buyer first; shipping_address_id=1; product_ids 1,2,3 from seeded products.
Get all orders for the authenticated user.

**Mobile.** Lists orders for the authenticated user where **payment_status** is **paid**. Same item shape as Get Orders, plus **paid_at**, **escrow_status**, **courier_tracking_number**, **delivery_confirmed_at**, **delivery_confirmation_proof_url** when present. **Bearer** required.

Get order by id (numeric or ord_789). Response: order_number, status, payment_status (unpaid/paid), subtotal, shipping_fee, total, items[], **paid_at**, **escrow_status**, **courier_tracking_number**, **delivery_confirmed_at**, **delivery_confirmation_proof_url**.

Initiates a direct **Airtel Money Malawi** Collection push (USSD prompt on the customer's phone).

**Auth:** Bearer — customer who owns the order.

**Body:**
- `msisdn` (required) — e.g. `0998256737` or `+265998256737` (sent to Airtel as `998256737`)

**Server flow:**
1. Validates order belongs to user and is not already paid.
2. Obtains OAuth2 token from `POST https://openapi.airtel.mw/auth/oauth2/token` (auto-refreshed every ~150s; warmed on server start).
3. Calls Airtel `POST https://openapi.airtel.mw/merchant/v1/payments/` with:
   - `reference` = order `order_number`
   - `transaction.id` = unique random id (e.g. `RFYYGhuhSerrIhUY`) — **not** the order id
   - `transaction.amount` = string MWK amount
4. Saves `airtel_transactions` row linking `transaction_id` → order.
5. Customer confirms on phone → **`POST /api/webhooks/airtel`** marks order paid.

**Env:** `AIRTEL_CLIENT_ID`, `AIRTEL_CLIENT_SECRET`, optional `AIRTEL_ENV=production`, `AIRTEL_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.

**Local test:** `npm run test-airtel-payment -- 0998256737`

See `docs/AIRTEL_WEBHOOK.md`.

request.description: **After Pay Changu client/checkout success.** Body: **tx_ref** (or **txRef**). Server calls Pay Changu verify API with **PAYCHANGU_SECRET_KEY**, checks amount/currency and **meta** (or tx_ref = order_number), then sets **payment_status** paid + escrow (same as webhooks). Idempotent if already paid. **Bearer** (customer who owns the order).
Cancel order. Only allowed when status is pending. No body required.

Mark payment as complete (call after payment gateway confirms or admin verifies payment). Funds are held in escrow. **Seller Impact:** Seller's transaction status changes from 'pending' to 'processing' (payment received, held in escrow). Money will be released to seller wallet when admin marks order as 'delivered'. Automatically notifies admin and seller.

Customer confirms delivery after order **status** is **delivered**. Releases escrow to seller. **Optional body** (omit or `{}` if no file): **file_url**, **proof_url**, **delivery_proof_url**, or **confirmation_file_url** — public URL of an uploaded photo/PDF (max 2048 chars); stored as **delivery_confirmation_proof_url**. Only the buyer (order owner) may call. Response **data** includes **delivery_confirmation_proof_url** when set.

Update order status. Available to sellers and admin. Can update status (pending, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled) and add courier tracking number. **Note:** Only admin can mark as 'delivered' (which auto-releases escrow to seller).

item.name: 11. Shops
item.description: Shop discovery (mobile & web). **`GET /api/shops`** — list **all** shops in `data` (no auth; includes `followers_count`, `total_products`, `joined_date`, etc.; no server pagination). **`GET /api/shops/:id`** — detail + `points_mwk_per_point` (MWK per loyalty point when redeeming that shop’s point balance; null if disabled) + `is_following` when Bearer sent. **`GET /api/shops/:id/products`** — paginated catalog. **Follow / Unfollow** require customer Bearer.

request.description: List all shops in `data`. Each shop includes `id`, `name`, `logo`, `location`, `is_verified`, `joined_date`, `total_products`, **`followers_count`**, and listing fields (`rating`, `total_reviews`, etc.). The server returns the full list (no server-side pagination on this route).

Single shop in `data`: **`followers_count`**, **`total_products`**, **`joined_date`**, **`points_mwk_per_point`** (MWK per loyalty point for redemptions from this shop’s balance; null if disabled), contact/location, `is_verified`, etc. **`is_following`**: `false` when this request uses **noauth**; set collection Bearer (`{{access_token}}`) or inherit auth to get the real follow state for the logged-in user.

Same as **Get Shop Details** (includes **`points_mwk_per_point`**) but uses the collection **Bearer** token so `data.is_following` reflects whether `{{access_token}}` belongs to a user who follows shop `1`. Log in as buyer first and set `access_token`.
Paginated products for a shop: `data.products` + `data.pagination`. Replace `1` with shop id.

**Bearer required.** Follow shop `1` (replace id). Shop must be **approved** and **active**. Sellers **cannot** follow their own shop. Response `data`: `shop_id`, `is_following: true`, **`followers_count`** (updated). Idempotent: already following → `200` with current counts.

**Bearer required.** Remove the current user as a follower of shop `1`. Response `data`: `is_following: false`, **`followers_count`** (updated). If the user was not following, still returns success with the current count.

item.name: 16. Webhooks
item.description: Inbound payment callbacks. **Airtel Money (Malawi):** register `{APP_URL}/api/webhooks/airtel` in the Airtel developer portal. Token + Collection API use `https://openapi.airtel.mw`. See `docs/AIRTEL_WEBHOOK.md`.

request.description: Health check for the Airtel callback URL (GET/HEAD). Returns `{ success: true, message: 'Airtel webhook endpoint is up' }`. Use before registering the URL in the Airtel Money developer portal.

header.value: <HMAC-SHA256 hex of raw JSON body; required when AIRTEL_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set>

request.description:
Called by Airtel Money Malawi after a Collection payment event.

**Auth:** None by default. When `AIRTEL_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is set, include header **`x-airtel-signature`** = HMAC-SHA256 hex of the **raw** JSON body.

**Payload notes:**
- `transaction.id` matches the unique id sent in the outbound push (e.g. `yHQzUnEzMKGitOke`) — server looks up `airtel_transactions` to resolve the order.
- `reference` is often omitted in callbacks; server falls back to the stored `reference` (`order_number`) from the push row.
- `status_code: "TS"` or nested `status.success: true` = payment success → order marked **paid** + escrow.
- Shop subscriptions: `reference` may be `SUB-{id}-…`.

**Always returns HTTP 200** (Airtel callback contract). Set `WEBHOOK_CAPTURE_ONLY=true` to log only.

See `docs/AIRTEL_WEBHOOK.md`.

header.value: <HMAC-SHA256 hex of raw JSON body; omit for local dev if secret not set>

request.description: **Configure in Pay Changu → Settings → API & Webhooks.** POST JSON + **Signature** header (HMAC-SHA256 of raw body). Server verifies signature (when **PAYCHANGU_SECRET_KEY** or **PAYCHANGU_WEBHOOK_SECRET** set), then **GET verify-payment/{tx_ref}** using **tx_ref** from **charge_id** or **tx_ref** in body. Marks order paid when verify succeeds and **meta** matches (or use **POST .../orders/:id/pay/paychangu** from the app). Returns **200** JSON (Pay Changu retries on non-2xx).

Return/callback URL after hosted checkout: Pay Changu redirects the user’s browser here with **query** params (**status**, **tx_ref**, etc.). Server verifies via Pay Changu API then marks order paid. Optional env **PAYCHANGU_REDIRECT_SUCCESS** / **FAILURE** for 302 after processing. Prefer **POST /api/webhooks/paychangu** for Flutter reliability.

  "phone": "+265991234567",
  "email": "shop@example.com",
  "logo_url": "https://example.com/logo.png",
  "images": [],
  "points_mwk_per_point": 25
}

request.description: **Bearer: seller JWT** (approved shop). `PATCH /api/sellers/:shopId/shop`. Send only fields to change. Supported: `name` or `shop_name`, `description`, `location`, `address`, `phone`, `email`, `logo` or `logo_url`, `images` (JSON), **`points_mwk_per_point`** (non-negative MWK credited per **1** loyalty point when customers redeem **this shop’s** point balance; `null` or empty string to disable). Response: `success`, `data` = updated shop row. Not accepted: `status`, `application_status`, `is_verified`, license / verification URLs — use **Admin** shop endpoints for those. Set collection variable **`shop_id`** to match the JWT user’s shop.

Seller self signup endpoint used before accessing seller APIs. Creates a seller user and a shop with status 'inactive' and application_status 'pending'. After this, call /api/auth/verify-otp (type=signup), then an admin must approve the shop via /api/admin/shops/{shopId}/approve before the seller can access /api/sellers/* routes.

Get onboarding status for the authenticated seller. Returns whether the account is verified and whether the shop is pending approval, approved, rejected, or inactive. Use this on the seller page to show messages like 'Your shop is pending approval' and update automatically once approved. Requires seller auth, but works even if the shop is not yet approved.
Get seller dashboard statistics. Includes overview.balance (available_balance, pending_escrow, can_withdraw). Requires seller role.

item.name: Subscription
item.description: **Two flows:** (1) **User** — `GET /api/plans`, `POST /api/subscribe` (JWT seller/admin), `GET /api/subscription/status/:userId`, `GET /api/subscription/ping` (requires active user subscription). Uses `user_subscriptions` + simulated payment. See SUBSCRIPTION_API.md. (2) **Shop subscription** (Pay Changu **`pay/paychangu`** verify flow) — routes below with `shop_id`.

request.description: Public. Returns `data.plans`: id, name, price (MWK), duration (days), features. Same DB as subscription_packages.
Seller or admin JWT. Body: planId, method. User from token only. 402 if simulated payment fails (SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_SIMULATE_FAILURE=true).
Seller: own `subscription_payments` only. Admin: all + optional filters `user_id`, `status`, `plan_id`, `from`, `to`, `page`, `limit`.
Self or admin. `data.has_access` + `data.subscription` when active and in-period.
JWT + requireActiveSubscription. 403 without valid user subscription.

data.subscription, recent_subscriptions, paychangu_payment_options. Each subscription has **subscribed** (true only when **active** + **paid** + in-period), effective_status, payment_status. Seller + approved shop.

Subscribe the shop to a plan. If an active subscription exists, send `replace_existing: true` to switch. By default new rows are pending until Pay Changu confirms or `payment_reference`. Set `SUBSCRIPTION_AUTO_ACTIVATE=true` only for dev to skip payment. Production: **Pay subscription (pay/paychangu)**. Requires seller role.

Body: `subscription_id`, `package_id`, `tx_ref` (from completing payment client-side with the Pay Changu SDK). Server re-verifies `tx_ref` with Pay Changu, checks it matches this subscription and amount, then activates on success. **200 response** includes **data.subscription** (fresh DTO).
Cancel: `immediately: false` (default) = at end of billing period; `true` = cancel now. Requires seller role.
Clears `cancel_at_period_end` if you changed your mind before the period ends. Requires seller role.

Get earnings summary: available_balance (withdrawable), pending_escrow (held until admin marks delivered), total_released, and orders_in_escrow. Transaction statuses: 'pending' (order placed, no payment), 'processing' (payment received, held in escrow), 'completed' (delivered, money in wallet). Sellers can only withdraw available balance. Requires seller role.
Submit withdrawal request. Only available balance (released from escrow) can be withdrawn. Min MK 1,000. withdrawal_method: mobile_money or bank_transfer. Admin must approve. Requires seller role.
List authenticated seller's withdrawal requests. Requires seller role.

Get seller wallet balance. Returns available_balance (withdrawable), pending_escrow (held until delivery confirmation), can_withdraw. Wallet is for sellers only; customers pay at checkout via card/mobile money.

Get seller wallet transaction history. Transaction statuses: 'pending' (order placed, waiting payment), 'processing' (payment received, held in escrow), 'completed' (delivered, money in wallet). Includes credits from escrow releases and debits from withdrawals. Seller only.

item.name: Categories
item.description: Categories are created by admin only. Sellers use this list to select a category when adding or editing products.

request.description: Get all admin-created categories. Use these category IDs when creating or updating products (category_id). Sellers cannot create categories. Requires seller role; replace 1 with your shop ID.

request.description: Get seller notifications with advanced filtering. Supports filtering by type, read status, date range, and priority sorting.
Get comprehensive notification statistics for seller including counts by type, urgent notifications, and today's notifications.
Get all unread order-related notifications for the seller with order details.
Get all payment-related notifications including escrow information.
Get all products for a shop. Requires seller role and shop ownership. Seed: shop_id=1 for seller@techaven.mw.

item.name: Delivery Agent APIs
item.description: APIs for delivery agents. Flow: 1) Register via /api/auth/register-delivery-agent 2) Verify OTP 3) Login 4) Set availability 5) Get available jobs 6) Accept/decline jobs 7) Pickup and deliver. Use Bearer {{access_token}} for protected endpoints.

request.description: Register as delivery agent. Body: full_name, password (required); email or phone_number required; vehicle_type, operating_zone, id_document_url optional. For file upload use multipart/form-data with id_document. Flow: 1) Call this 2) Verify OTP with /api/auth/verify-otp (type=signup) 3) Login.
Create or update delivery agent profile. For users who already have delivery_agent role (e.g. assigned by admin). Requires Bearer token. Supports multipart/form-data for id_document file upload.
Get delivery agent profile. Requires delivery_agent role.
Set agent availability to receive jobs. Requires delivery_agent role.

List all delivery jobs assigned to the logged-in agent. Response includes job_id, order_number, shop_name, pickup_address, dropoff_address, parcel_summary, delivery_fee, status, timestamps. Requires delivery_agent role.

List unassigned delivery jobs (when seller selects platform_agent). Response includes job_id, order_number, shop_name, pickup_address, dropoff_address, parcel_summary, delivery_fee. Requires delivery_agent role.
Accept a delivery job. Set job_id variable from Get Available Jobs response. Requires delivery_agent role.
Decline a job. Job is reassigned to other available agents. Requires delivery_agent role.
Mark parcel as picked up from seller. Order status -> shipped. Requires delivery_agent role.
Mark delivery complete. Order status -> delivered, starts buyer 72h confirmation window. Requires delivery_agent role.

item.name: Shop Owner Registration
item.description: APIs for invited shop owners to register and activate their seller account. Flow: 1) Admin invites owner → 2) Owner receives email with registration link → 3) Owner registers with invite_token → 4) Owner verifies OTP → 5) Owner accesses seller dashboard. See docs/OWNER_REGISTRATION.md for full flow.

request.description: Creates a seller account linked to the invited shop. Include invite_token from the registration link (/register?invite_token=xxx). Email or phone must match the invitation.
Verifies OTP after shop owner registration. Returns access_token and refresh_token. Use access_token for seller API calls.
Resends OTP if shop owner did not receive it after registration.
